body:
# Electromagnetic Blackout

* **Type:** Split-Effect Environment Modifier (`split_modifier`)
* **Thematic Profile:** High-yield EMP pulse or power grid failure rendering complex electronic optics dark.

## Split-Effect Rules by Active Stage Focus

* **If [Combat] Focus:** *Targeting HUDs Offline.* Characters **cannot re-roll failure faces** during this stage.
* **If [Intel] or [Operations] Focus:** *Defensive ICE Triggered.* All success thresholds are increased by **+1** (Primary hits on **4+**, Secondary on **5+**, Out of Focus on **6**).
* **If Other Focus ([Infiltrate], [Survival], [Negotiate]):** *Pitch-Black Terrain.* Natural **1s** (Backfires) inflict **+1 extra HP damage**.

* **Thematic Profile:** Ceiling-mounted automated turrets tracking movement in the operational zone.

## Split-Effect Rules by Active Stage Focus

* **Thematic Profile:** Heavy chemical smoke or aerosol coolant filling the facility.

## Split-Effect Rules by Active Stage Focus

* **If [Combat] Focus:** *Zero Visibility.* Natural **1s** and natural **2s** **both trigger Backfire damage**.

body:
# Wide-Band Signal Jammer

* **Type:** Split-Effect Technical Modifier (`split_modifier`)
* **Thematic Profile:** Military-grade scramblers blocking external communication links and AI telemetry relays.

## Split-Effect Rules by Active Stage Focus

* **If [Intel] or [Operations] Focus:** *Remote Servers Blocked.* Operatives **cannot activate Class Abilities** during this stage.
* **If [Negotiate] Focus:** *External Channels Severed.* All non-Specialist characters act as **Out of Focus (hitting on 5+ only)**.
* **If Other Focus ([Combat], [Infiltrate], [Survival]):** *Tactical Link Severed.* The Squad Leader cannot use *Logistical Refresh* (spending [EF] to restore dice) during this stage.

body:
# Explosive Fuel Craters

* **Type:** Generic High-Risk Hazard Modifier (`generic_modifier`)
* **Thematic Profile:** Exposed fuel lines or volatile plasma containers littering the floor.

## System Rules

* **Chain Reaction:** The **FIRST natural 1 (Backfire)** rolled by any character during this stage detonates local volatile canisters, dealing **1 point of HP damage to EVERY deployed character** in the room.
* Submitting subsequent natural 1s causes normal single-target Backfire damage.
